newsitem.title: GREECE: ATHLETICS-WORLD SHOT CHAMPION BAGACH TESTS POSITIVE - OFFICIAL.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-WORLD SHOT CHAMPION BAGACH TESTS POSITIVE - OFFICIAL.

text.p: World shot put champion Alesksandr Bagach of the Ukraine has been stripped of his gold medal after testing positive for a stimulant, the International Amateur Athletic Federation (IAAF) said on Thursday.
The IAAF said in a statement that American John Godina, the 1995 champion, would now get the gold medal, German Oliver-Sven Buder the silver and American C.J. Hunter the bronze.
French men's 400 metres hurdler Pascal Maran and women's triple jumper Oxana Zelinkskaya of Kazakhstan have tested positive for the stimulant ephedrine.
"Following the recent decision by the IAAF congress, these athletes will be issued a public warning and disqualified from the competition," the statement said.
